meta.title: LisanHub — community language learning
meta.description: Learn any language from any language, with content the community creates, reviews and improves.

home.title: Learn any language, starting from yours
home.lede: A platform whose content is built together by learners, native speakers and content creators: lessons, exercises and review cards for every language pair.
home.pillarsTitle: What the platform is built on

freedom.title: Learn freely
freedom.body: No single mandatory path. Move between lessons and resources according to your level and interests.

community.title: Content from the community
community.body: Content creators publish, translate and improve, with clear attribution and a record of every change.

progress.title: Your progress is always kept
progress.body: Your progress and review dates are stored for free in your account and follow you to any device.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lede: One free account for all your languages and your progress.
signUp.usernameHint: Yours alone, Latin letters, digits, _ and . only, at least 4 characters.
signUp.displayNameHint: The name the community sees, in any language. Leave it empty to use your username.

checkEmail.title: One last step: confirm your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent the confirmation link to
checkEmail.step1: Open your inbox (check the spam folder if needed).
checkEmail.step2: Click the confirmation link in this same browser.
checkEmail.step3: You will be signed in automatically.
checkEmail.resent: Link sent again. It can take a minute to arrive.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.lede: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that address is registered with us, you will receive a link to choose a new password. Open it in the browser you requested it from.

reset.title: New password
reset.needSession: The recovery link has expired or was opened in another browser. Request a new link.

errors.other_browser: The recovery link was opened in a different browser. Request a new link from this browser and open it here.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits, _ and . only, 4–30 characters. Shown as @user_name61.
profile.uiLocaleHint: Only the language of menus and pages; it never affects the languages you learn.
profile.visibilityRestrictedHint: Only you and the moderation team can see your profile. Your name stays on what you publish, for attribution.
profile.displayNameHint: In any language. Shown to the community together with your username.
profile.bioHint: In any language. Shown on your public page.
profile.locationHint: City or country, the way you want it shown.
profile.publicLinkHint: A unique link others can see; it changes if you change your username.

role.title: Your role in the community
role.studentExplanation: A student learns, tracks progress and keeps personal copies of lessons on their own device; they never publish content to the community.
role.creatorExplanation: As a content creator you can create lessons and cards, publish them to the community, and make your own version of other people's lessons or translate them. The creation tools arrive in the next stage.
role.ownerNote: As the platform owner no rank or role limits you: every permission is open to you, and you can try the platform with narrower permissions from the “View the platform as” bar at the top of the page.

notices.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Welcome to LisanHub.
notices.content_creator: Done: your account is now a content creator account.

errors.not_allowed: This action is not available for your account.
errors.already_content_creator: You are already a content creator.
errors.role_change_not_allowed: This role change is not available at this stage.
errors.pair_exists: This language pair is already added.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
errors.acknowledge_required: Confirm that you have read the commitments first.
errors.request_pending: You already have a request of this kind under review.
errors.upload_failed: The picture could not be uploaded. Try again.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.studentBody: Yours is a student account. Publishing to the community requires a content creator account, a change that is only undone through support.
advanced.becomeLink: Switch to a content creator account…
advanced.creatorBody: Yours is a content creator account. To return to a student account, contact support; the team reviews your case and decides.

creator.title: Become a content creator
creator.lede: One step changes the nature of your account. Read the commitments, then confirm.

commitments.publish: What you publish becomes available to the whole community; others can make their own version of it or translate it, with attribution to you.
commitments.attribution: Your name stays attached to everything you publish and to every derived version.
commitments.rules: You follow the community rules: original or reusable educational content, without abuse or rights violations.
commitments.review: New content carries the “new community content” label until the founding team reviews it, and the community can report it.
commitments.noReturn: You cannot return to a student account by yourself; that goes through support after a review of your case.

creator.acknowledge: I have read the commitments and understand this change is only undone through support.
creator.alreadyCreator: Yours is already a content creator account.
creator.returnViaSupport: To return to a student account, send a request to support from the “Account type and support” page.
creator.backToAdvanced: Back to Account type and support

soon.theme: Theme (light/dark) instead of following the device

security.newEmailHint: A confirmation link goes to both the old and the new address; the change applies after both confirm.
security.emailChangeSent: Link sent. Open both messages to complete the change.
security.sessionsBody: Sign out of this device from the account menu at the top of the page. Managing other devices comes later.
security.confirmEmail: Confirmation links will go to both addresses. Continue?

support.title: Contact support
support.body: Write to us here; your request reaches the moderation team directly and you can follow its status below.

hints.revert_to_student: Briefly explain why you want to return to a student account. Support reviews your case and decides.
hints.other: Any question or problem with your account. Suggestions about the platform will get their own form later.

submit.revert_to_student: Request a return to a student account

support.sent: Request sent. The reply will appear here and in your notifications.
support.pendingRevert: Your request to return to a student account is under review.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. Shown as a circle.
avatar.confirmUpload: Replace your picture with this one?

languages.title: My language pairs
languages.lede: Each pair joins a language you start from and a language you are learning. Nothing here is mandatory: you can browse and learn at any time.
languages.empty: You have not added a pair yet.

add.title: Add a language pair
add.nativeHint: Your native language or one you know well.
add.dialectHint: For example: algerian or egyptian. Results in this dialect come first, without hiding the others.
add.goalHint: A short sentence, such as "Study in France".

picker.placeholder: Search by English name or code (kab, French…)
picker.noResults: No results. Try the English name or the ISO 639-3 code.

dashboard.ledeStudent: This is your space. Add your languages and set up your account; lessons and the community will appear here as they are ready.
dashboard.ledeCreator: This is your space as a content creator. The editor and publishing tools arrive in the next stage, right here.

languages.title: My languages
languages.body: {count, plural, =0 {No pair added yet} one {# language pair} other {# language pairs}}

account.title: My account
account.body: Profile, preferences, security and account type.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Requests, reports, feedback, members and settings.

dashboard.soonBody: Sections follow the build roadmap; each one switches on at its stage.

learning.title: Learning
learning.body: Browse lessons, the lesson player and spaced review.

myContent.title: My content
myContent.body: Your published lessons, courses and cards, plus drafts.

editor.title: Editor
editor.body: Write lessons in blocks, exercises, preview and versions.

chats.title: Chats
chats.body: The founders chat, then rooms per language pair.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Everything about your content, requests and reports.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lede: Moderators and administrators only. Every action here is written to the audit log.

content.title: Content
content.hint: Fills up with the editor in S2.

requests.title: Support requests
requests.lede: Grouped by kind, oldest first. Only an administrator executes a return to a student account.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lede: Content and conduct reports, newest first.
reports.emptyContent: No content reports (they arrive with S2).
reports.emptyConduct: No conduct reports (they arrive with chats, S5).

feedback.title: Platform feedback
feedback.lede: “Your opinion on the platform”, grouped by category. Change the status to track what was acted on.
feedback.empty: No feedback yet (the form arrives with S6).

users.title: Members
users.lede: Find a member and change their role or rank according to your permissions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Changed here without a new release. Pick from the options; nothing to type.
settings.readOnly: Read only; editing is reserved for administrators.

moderation_escalation_open_reports.label: Open reports before escalation
moderation_escalation_open_reports.description: Open reports (error/violation/outdated) on one item before it moves to the moderation queue.

lineage_derivation_notify_threshold.label: Derived versions before notifying the author
lineage_derivation_notify_threshold.description: Published versions derived from one lesson before its author is notified.

quality_community_trusted_min_ratings.label: Minimum ratings for “Community trusted”
quality_community_trusted_min_ratings.description: Content does not carry the label before this number.

founding_window_open.label: Founding members window
founding_window_open.description: Do new sign-ups receive the permanent “founding member” badge?

support_email.label: Support address (optional)
support_email.description: Requests arrive inside the platform; leave empty if you do not want an extra address.

publishing.label: Publishing
publishing.description: Publishing new content to the community.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.description: When on, the platform is read-only for everyone with a maintenance notice.

errors.own_rank: You cannot change your own rank.

profile.moreSoon: Lessons, contributions and ratings will appear on this page in the coming stages.

viewAs.label: View the platform as
viewAs.active: You are viewing the platform with the permissions of: {rank}
viewAs.note: Limits the interface and actions only; the database still knows you as the owner.
